context: Mei and Yumiko fold laundry on the porch on a sunny afternoon.
purpose: Domestic quiet bonding through shared household work.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Today's the perfect day for laundry.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft, unhurried delivery. The contentment of someone who knows how to read the weather. No hurry, just noting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet wonder at something simple. Breathing in the moment. Gentle, almost drowsy in its pleasure. Eyes half-closed, face turned up slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 布団も干したわよ、ほら。
lines.en: I've hung the futon out too — look.
lines.style: Light pride in small domestic care. Slight lilt upward on 'look' — offering the sight to be shared. Practical but affectionate, the work already done and worth noticing together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふかふか、気持ちよさそう。
lines.en: So fluffy — it'll be so comfortable.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, almost admiring. Soft smile in the voice. The simple pleasure of anticipating rest. No irony, just warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quiet assurance. The kind of certainty that comes from small, reliable things. Soft, almost thinking aloud. A promise without pressure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お母さん、いつもありがとう。
lines.style: Soft, sincere gratitude. Not performative. A moment of quiet recognition. Slight pause before 'like always' — understanding runs deep.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、当たり前のことよ。
lines.en: Heh — it's just what I do.
lines.style: Small warm laugh. Gentle dismissal of the thanks — not denial, just the natural rhythm of care. Unhurried, fond. The security of someone who doesn't need recognition to know her love matters.
